files.description: Repo-wide conventions: moon task runner, docker naming, scope discipline, MDR rule, git rules

rules.rule: No real patient data in fixtures, screenshots, seeds or logs. Flag anything that looks like a real name, Belgian national register number (RRN/INSZ), address or FHIR payload with real identifiers. Logging FHIR payloads counts as logging PHI.
Every docker container, volume, network and built image must be prefixed `zas_`.
Scripts, CI, docs and moon.yml must invoke tasks via `moon run …`, not raw `uv run`, `pnpm exec`, `docker compose run` or env-prefixed commands, when a moon task exists.
Every proposal.md must contain a `**Tier**:` line citing exactly one of `[poc]`, `[mvp]`, `[product]`.
A new clinical view must declare its surfaces (`app`, `smart`, `embed`) via `defineFeature`. Pages under `/_auth/admin/*`, `/_auth/settings` and `/_auth/pathways/*` must not call `defineFeature`.
Flag MDR drift: clinical decision logic, diagnostic output, automated dosing, or interpreting Luscii measurements ourselves. We must never become an MDR medical device.
